name: United Gateway Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 12 months from account opening on purchases. After the intro period, a variable APR of 19.74% (Min. of (6.75+12.99) and 29.99%) to 28.24% (Min. of (6.75+21.49) and 29.99%).

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made with your Gateway Card outside the U.S.

categories.label: Local transit and commuting (ride share, taxicabs, train tickets, tolls, mass transit)

rewards.redemption_notes: Miles earned automatically transferred to United MileagePlus after end of each billing cycle. Miles can be used for flights on United and other airline partners. No blackout dates on United-operated flights.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 30,000 bonus miles after you spend $1,000 on purchases in the first 3 months your account is open. Plus, earn 10,000 bonus miles after you add an authorized user in the first 3 months. Total up to 40,000 bonus miles.

benefits.title: 2 Checked Bag Certificates After $10K Spend
benefits.description: Earn two standard checked bag certificates after spending $10,000 on purchases with your United Gateway Card within a calendar year. Each unused certificate expires 12 months after date of issue.

benefits.title: 25% Back on United Inflight Purchases
benefits.description: 25% back as a statement credit on purchases of food, beverages and Wi-Fi on board United and United Express-operated flights, and on premium drink purchases at United Clubs.

benefits.title: Save 10%+ on Flights Booked with Miles After $10K Spend
benefits.description: Save 10% or more on flights booked with miles after spending $10,000 in a calendar year. Premier members save even more.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made with your Gateway Card outside the U.S.

benefits.title: 0% Intro APR for 12 Months
benefits.description: 0% intro APR for the first 12 months from account opening on purchases.

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: 2 checked bag certificates after $10,000 spend per calendar year
other: 25% back on United inflight food/beverage/Wi-Fi and Club premium drinks
Save 10%+ on award flights after $10,000 spend per calendar year

notes: United Gateway Card from Chase.
